name: pnp-list-formatting-sports-card
title: Sports Card
shortDescription: This SharePoint JSON view formatting sample transforms list items into vertical sports trading cards with header bar, country badge, player silhouette, name band, star rating and three stat bars.
longDescription: This SharePoint JSON view formatting sample transforms list items into vertical FIFA / NBA style trading cards.

Each card has a header bar with sport name and jersey number, a hero area with country badge and player silhouette, an accent-coloured name band, a star rating, three labelled stat bars and a short description. Colours, icons and stat values are all driven from list columns so each card can be re-skinned per item.

references.name: Use view formatting to customize SharePoint
references.description: You can use view formatting to customize how items in SharePoint lists and libraries are displayed.
